methods.label: Compare complements of the same angle
methods.explanation: Both \(\angle 2\) and \(\angle 3\) are complements of \(\angle 1\), so \(\angle 2=90^\circ-\angle 1=\angle 3\). The reason is that complements of the same angle are equal.
